subject: Mountain Lion Rattle Install Dependency Warnings (Rattle 2.6.21, R 2.15.2)

messages.author: 5670963b5e6c2b8d
messages.subject: Mountain Lion Rattle Install Dependency Warnings (Rattle 2.6.21, R 2.15.2)
parts:
Hello,

When I try to install rattle 2.6.21 on R 2.15.2 on Mountain Lion using this command:

> install.packages("rattle", dependencies = T)

I get the following warning in the R Console:

dependencies ‘graph’, ‘RBGL’, ‘pkgDepTools’, ‘Rgraphviz’ are not available
